wording: [Water Dome of the Deep Sea Currents]
holder-quote: Revine was not so happy about their proximity, though.
effect-quote: Her magic was more adaptive than he thought. He had no conception that she could use the dome of water offensively like that.

wording: [Water Dome of the Deep Sea Currents]
holder-quote: And the Siren laughed at him. She laughed—and popped out of place on her palanquin.
effect-quote: All the water she had shot in their fight—returned to Revine and reformed that deadly dome.
